assessmentBoundary: Three bounded exact families: complex root count including multiplicity, Descartes positive/negative upper sign-variation counts, conjugate complex partner. Full noninteger/complex root solving, polynomial construction, real graphing and tech lab teacher-scored.
uniqueLessonScope: Prior L13 actual cubic/quartic equation solving is distinct; L15 classifies all complex and repeated zeros and possible real sign-change counts by theorems.
